retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy 1980s rock aesthetic featuring a charismatic female subject in leather, paired with aggressive brush-stroke lettering and a clean white studio backdrop.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic studio portrait of a female rock icon with large, textured hair and a black leather jacket, set against a stark white background with a hard shadow. The composition is anchored by bold, red, hand-drawn brush lettering that overlaps the subject's silhouette.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned on the right third with a hard drop shadow against a white wall
Bold red script typography balancing the subject on the left side
High-contrast lighting emphasizing the texture of leather and hair
Tight secondary sans-serif text placed directly beneath the primary script
coreInvariants: Hard-edged shadow cast onto the background
Vibrant red primary accent color for text
Black leather and dark clothing as the central subject texture
Off-white or bright white negative space

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned on the right half of the frame, scaled to a three-quarter length portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large red initial of the script text act as dual anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the bold red text on the left, across the subject's face, down the leather jacket, and follows the shadow to the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space on the left side provides a canvas for the primary typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value background with high saturation red; subject features deep blacks and warm skin tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Vertical, condensed brush script with exaggerated ascenders and descenders.
letterConstructionRules: Sharp, tapered ends on vertical stems
Irregular baseline for a hand-painted feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial letters are significantly larger and serve as graphic pillars
Crossbars are thin and sharp, resembling blade strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive, textured script paired with a clean, widely-spaced geometric sans-serif for legibility and balance.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aggressive, dry-brush energy of the display text.
Provides the clean, geometric contrast needed for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a woman with voluminous 80s hair wearing a black leather jacket, standing against a white wall with a hard shadow cast to the right. High contrast lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large red brush-script lettering on the left side, slightly overlapping the subject's arm. Below it, add a single line of all-caps sans-serif text with very wide letter spacing in black.

verificationChecks: Is the hair texture highly detailed?
Is the red text vibrant and brush-like?
Is there a hard shadow on the white background?
Is the subtitle text widely spaced?

mustRedesign: Do not use the specific name of the artist
Do not replicate the exact album title text
Avoid using specific brand logos on the clothing

mustAchieve: Clear separation between subject and white background

postGenerationChecks: Verify brush texture on large text
Ensure subtitle tracking is sufficiently wide
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Hard Shadow + White Background + [Subject in Leather] + [Red Brush Script] + [Wide-spaced Sans-Serif Subtitle]
